# pnpm audit allowlist for the `security` job (ADR-0030, as amended).
#
# One advisory per line:   <GHSA-id> <review-by YYYY-MM-DD> <reason, free text>
#
# A line is allowed only for a finding triaged as NOT REACHABLE in what ships, for
# example a package that exists only at build time and never reaches the nginx-served
# static bundle. A reachable finding is fixed (a dependency bump), never listed here.
# Both frontends list their build tools under `dependencies`, so --prod does not remove
# them from the audit; this file is how a build-time-only finding is recorded as triaged.
#
# `pnpm-audit.sh` fails the job on any entry past its review-by date, whether or not the
# advisory still exists, so a suppression cannot outlive its reason. A review-by date more
# than 90 days ahead of the day the job runs is rejected too, so no entry is permanent.
#
# Do NOT add a line to make a red run green. Same rule as .gitleaksignore.
